title: Header — Utility Bar
description: The header's slim top band: the Trustpilot mark, the Call Us disclosure and the enquiry action. Matches live's `.sd-top-menu-wrapper` — neutral-200 ground, no vertical padding of its own so its full-height children sit flush top and bottom. The 56px band height is `custom.header.utility-height`, set as `dimensions.minHeight` on the row inside this band in patterns/header.php: it has to be on the row, because this band is a constrained (block-level) group and a minHeight here would leave the row at content height with dead space beneath it. The ground is the same neutral-200 the header row uses, so the two bands read as one field and the logo can overhang between them.
